QuestInfo.name: The Right to Own a Home
QuestInfo.0: #p229# of #m10001007# seems to have a new offer for me.
QuestInfo.1: #p229# of #m10001007# said he had some good news, and told me that I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find #b#p230##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p230# of #m10001007# told me all about houses.

0.0: #h0#, I was just looking for you. I have some wonderful news to share with you. Would you like to hear it?

yes.0: Wonderful. I know you've put a lot of effort into #m10001000#, so we've decided to grant you the right to own a house. Isn't that exciting?
yes.1: You look like you have plenty of questions, like how to get a house and what perks come with owning one. Haha. In that case, you should go meet #b#p230##k here first. He can tell you all the details. Congratulations again!

no.0: Hmm, I didn't expect you to turn this down.

1.0: So you're #h0#. I've heard quite a bit about you from #p229#. We're currently getting ready to offer houses to those who've recently become residents of #m10001000#, and it looks like you're our lucky one.
1.1: What can you do with a house, you ask? Haha, glad you asked. In your own home, you can decorate to your heart's content with furniture you love, and even set up conveniences like storage and a crafting station. You can also use #b#t2030010##k to head straight home, and that's just the start of the perks.
1.2: On top of that, you can invite friends over to your place, or pay a visit to someone else's. Spending as much time as you like with friends in a cozy home of your own, what could be better than that?

npc.0: #p230# over here can tell you a lot more about houses.
